boundary.scope_equality: validateJudgmentDAG requires exact scope.type and scope.id equality for dependencies before runner calls

evidence.scope_note: VibePro's multi-tenant contract uses its supported self_hosted/dedicated vocabulary to describe the caller-owned execution boundary. J0 only validates exact node scope equality on dependency edges and creates an in-memory run record; it does not implement hosted tenant resolution or authorization, persistence partitioning, connection lookup, data retrieval, secret isolation, audit, sandbox, or deployment guarantees. Those surfaces remain not applicable and require independent review if this boundary changes.
